label: DSP iam.receive — accept the participant credential into the tenant wallet
info: POST /iam/credentials/offers (admin, Bearer DSP_ADMIN_TOKEN): the connector accepts its participant credential, offered by the federation issuer, into its own W-Stack tenant. The offer is resolved by the tenant's retrieval service, checked (trusted issuer, SD-JWT VC of the participant type), then accepted with the tenant's key or refused and deleted. The participant decides what enters its wallet; the federation issuer only offers.

name: admin check, hand the offer to the tenant retrieval service
offer resolved? read it
trusted issuer and participant credential type? accept or refuse
outcome (never the credential)
